title: Regular Freshman Admissions, Fall 2027-28
about: AUB regular freshman admissions for Fall 2027-28. The application window opens November 1, 2026 and closes December 20, 2026; decisions are expected by the end of March 2027.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Regular Freshman Admissions, Fall 2027-28 at the American University of Beirut (AUB), Beirut, Lebanon, application deadline 20 Dec 2026. The photo shows the blue-domed Mohammad Al-Amin Mosque with its minarets in downtown Beirut, with the port and the sea behind it.
